cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Why I missed our anniversary dinner belongs in the calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having the replacement dinner now. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. This booking covers dinner, not the review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll cancel dessert and we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need to resolve the cancellation before opening a second complaint.
